findings.observation: The adult soft-rectangular freckled face, medium-deep skin, wide-set eyes, low straight brow, rounded nose, wide mouth, and calm closed-mouth expression remain unmistakably Wenyn Falek.
The very-short compact silhouette preserves the summon’s plus-size heavy natural mass, shoulder and torso widths, softness, leg mass, and grounded posture.
Upper arms, forearms, wrists, and hands retain the source-relative natural proportions without generic chibi inflation.
The matte blue-teal pageboy bob, front sweep, side silhouette, parting, gathered mass, shaved side, and hidden-undercut treatment match the summon.

The terracotta-black tunic-tabard, high collar, layered hems, loose trousers, ankle wraps, and tattoo cuff are faithful, but the separate clay tea token held in the summon is missing; the existing waist ring and tassel are not that token.
Measured topmost hair to lower hair/neck boundary at about 426 pixels over an approximately 1,215-pixel standing figure, yielding about 35.1 percent and satisfying the strict 32–36 percent lock.
Exactly one full-body adult chibi is present with the entire head, both hands, and both feet visible inside generous safe margins.
The grounded three-quarter ready-idle stance, compact silhouette, planted feet, and empty hands read clearly at combat-icon scale without a weapon.
The image remains an ordinary mortal presentation with no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, floating, frame, star, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect.
